causal_sequence: CPU1 is halted in WAITI0 with a pending compare at 160MHz.
At the same virtual nanosecond, 160-to-40MHz recomputes the entire elapsed CCOUNT and drops its visible count; the original compare timer deadline is unchanged.
That deadline fires before the new count reaches compare; the guest tick handler advances its existing compare value and schedules it several virtual seconds away.
40-to-240MHz then jumps the count forward while retaining that several-second timer deadline. The original interrupt watchdog fires before the next CPU1 tick.
